ZOHO_MCP_SERVER_URL.title: Zoho MCP server URL
ZOHO_MCP_SERVER_URL.description: Server URL generated for your Zoho MCP server, copied from the Connect section of the Zoho MCP console (mcp.zoho.com, or the console for your data-center region). It embeds an API key — treat it like a password.
